structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems

law.catch_line: Virginia Aviation Board and Virginia Port Authority powers
law.text: The powers of the Virginia Aviation Board set out in Chapter 1 (§ 5.1-1 et seq.) of Title 5.1 and the Virginia Port Authority set out in Chapter 10 (§ 62.1-128 et seq.) of Title 62.1 are in no way diminished by the provisions of this title.
